text: Can someone tell me the titles of the lore relevant videos in order pls
author: @ivanhidalgo8718

replies.text:
Twilight Sparkle Shows Trixie The True Meaning Of Friendship Whether She Likes It Or Not - First inklings of a relationship between Twilight and Trixie. 
My Little Pony The Movie: The Death Of Twilight Sparkle - Trixie becomes Luna's apprentice, Creation of Flawless (antagonist). 
My Little Pony The Movie: Shattered Harmony - Return and redemption of Flawless, secret split of Flawless’s personality and the creation of Fractured, Creation of Changeling Drone #13240. 
My Little Pony Coco Pommel Has Her Heart Stolen – First appearance of Marionette/Mary (antagonist).
My Little Pony The Movie: The Death Of Trixie Lulamoon – Continues from previous episode, confrontation between Trixie and Mary. Trixie becomes a goddess. She destroys the world, then brings it back, accidentally genderbends Shining Armor and Cadence. 
Flawless FARTS Open a PORTAL To ANOTHER DIMENSION?!! 0c0 – Return and redemption of Mary. First reference to Trixiebelle.
My Little Pony: Trixie Gets Fired – First appearance of Trixiebelle (in disguise).
MY LITTLE PONY THE MOVIE: SWEETIE BELLE IN LOVE – Another appearance of Changeling Drone #13240, now older. Flawless, a grown-ass woman, is shown going to grade school. Fem-Shining Armor is defeated and Shining Armor and Cadence are restored.
My Little Pony: Trixie Meets Twilight's Parents And Immediately Regrets It... – Twilight acknowledges her wife and daughter to her parents, first appearance of Fractured.
My Little Pony: HUGE Fight Breaks Out At Chuck E. Cheese – Second appearance of Fractured, Flawless uses kiss-therapy on her. Mary saves a city from Fractured-corrupted Tirek.
My Little Pony - The WORST Skii Trip Of Pinkie Pie's LIFE – Flawless introduces Fractured to her parents. Twilight gains the power of a dragon. 
MY LITTLE PONY - THE ABYSS – Starlight uses Starswirl’s magic staff to enter the Abyss. Mary saves the entire universe. Twilight gains her Abyssal form. Somehow… fem-Shining Armor now exists alongside Shining Armor.
Twilight Sparkle takes Trixie to a Japanese Bath House because she Smells Bad – First appearance of the handicapped ponies. Changeling Drone #13240 searches for her true dad.
My Little Pony X DBZ X Sonic Underground - The Tournament of Power!! – Flawless and Fractured merge to become more powerful and help save their universe. Another appearance of Trixiebelle (in disguise).
MY LITTLE PONY THE MOVIE: Trixie & Trixiebelle – Trixiebelle’s true form is revealed (lol) and his past. Gets redemption. Scootaloo goes feral, bites Twilight (starts her werewolf arc). Second appearance of Abyssal form Twilight.
MY LITTLE PONY: Twilight Sparkle Becomes A Werewolf – Twilight’s werewolf form is revealed. First present-day appearance of Skywishes (vampire). Trixie becomes a vampire. Starcatcher’s original fate is shown. Mary becomes a werewolf.
MY LITTLE PONY: TWILIGHT HURTS PRINCESS CELESTIA'S FEELINGS – Twilight is still a werewolf and Trixie is still a vampire (previous treatment failed). Trixiebelle is now Belle and works for Trixie. Gets bullied (sexually). 
MY LITTLE PONY: MONSTER SCHOOL!! – Everyone who is still a monster gets chucked into a monster school by Celestia (who secretly plans to kill all the students and purify Equestria). She fails. Belle is repeatedly bullied (sexually). Changeling Drone #13240 finally connects with her dad, Shining Armor. Skywishes is haunted by the ghost of Starcatcher. Gets goaded by Fractured into killing her vampire self with the salt staff (ending up in the Salt Zone). Flawless and Fractured have an epic duel and reconcile. Redemption of Fractured. Trixie makes a deal with Celestia to make all monster ponies normal with her power of illusion. Secretly this makes Starcatcher (a ghost) become a normal pony again. 
MY LITTLE PONY: Career Day – First episode showing Fractured as part of Twilight and Trixie’s family. Hijinks at grade school where she and Flawless, two grown-ass women, go to.
MY LITTLE PONY: THE SALT ZONE! –  Were we are now.

I forget which episode had the first flashback to Starcatcher and Skywishes. lol

text:
Ahh, I see we've reached the point in the series where it's finally starting to mirror the main one (in that the plot had to take twilight out of the picture so she didn't just solve the problem herself immediately. )


Anyways, I see that Soarin's exile is finally starting to visibly affect equestria, now that enough people have died that everyone's having to start resorting to alternative resurrection methods. (Hence causing the piss fairy infestation, since the everfree's fae are the most accessable resurrection service, and ponies, being naturally selfish and racist creatures, see no issue with selling out the very lives of their fellow citizens to guarantee their own resurrection, since they get turned into piss fairies and thus become incredibly racist to regular ponies again.)

No clue what happens to their souls when they die as piss fae, but as previously established, Ponies are inherently and biologically selfish and racist, so no one's willing to fund Twilight's research into the under-wilds to learn what happens to the bugs they hate after they kill them. The bugs that are so annoying, mind you, they actually lowered the rate of pony-on-changeling hate crimes inside equestria by over 80%, simply by proxy of them not inherently being race traitors that will kill you and feed your soul to the faerie king, Despot.
(Hence Chrysalis being allowed to live in ponyville, and changelings as a whole being allowed to exist in polite pony society, explaining why there were so many in the background of this episode, literally everywhere.)

((They were all transformed in their regular pony forms, but surprisingly not because of racism this time; since changelings don't piss, they were actually each waiting to get ambushed by piss faeries. As they lack bladders, Piss magic is completely useless, and they can then eat them.

Yeah turns out Changelings originally evolved to hunt Faeries in the same way those snakes with the freaky spider-shaped tails hunt birds. Who knew. Faerie flesh is apparently 87% love to boot.))

(((The ponies of equestria won't actually know this specifically until the first Fairy restaurant, 'Fae Kae-bab', opens up in Canterlot on February 28th 2027, serving up Fairies of all kinds, either raw and alive, like escargot or mussles, or having been cooked while alive, like lobsters or crab. 
They're genuinely just being less racist because the faeries are also vaguely bug-like and make the changelings look good in comparison, and since that's the only reason the three main pony races even tolerate eachother like they do, it just makes sense they'd all immediately change how they think of Changelings overnight and basically accept them as the fourth pony race of equestria, granting them nearly equal rights to everypony else.)))
[The Thestrals are MALDING about this, yes. Some stinky bugs get full citizenship overnight, but the bat-wings get relegated to being stuck in Princess Luna's fetish concentration camps just so she can have guards she finds hot that she can legally do whatever she wants to because they lack even the rights of a secondary citizen?]

((((What I'm saying is that if Braeburn ever finds him and Soarin a way home before the Everfree Fae find a way to reproduce/repopulate without buying the souls of the dead directly from hell to do so, the race war is ON and it'll be all his fault.))))




(((((I mean there are still race wars anyways in equestria all the time but this one would be legally sanctioned. Which also happens all the time but it'd be started by Celestia instead of just being approved by her hoofprint on a document she didn't bother to read before signing.)))))




Anyways I'm a little disappointed Two and Starlight didn't bang eachother's wives. Like imagine the things Marionette could've taught Twilight about sex as a werewolf that she could take back do to Trixie, who'd have comparatively the best night of her life after being subjected to what Starlight thinks is good sex and thinking her wife forgot how to plow.
I know YouTube's been watching you closer lately but you could've gotten away with it, trust

The action scenes were a nice substitute tho, I did still finish there, they were pretty good for the series, all things considered. 


All that aside, I do quite genuinely enjoy the dynamic Skywishes, Belle, and Star Catcher have, it's super interesting to see three formerly mortal immortals, who used to be a dysfunctional found-family, all finding eachother again a thousand years later, a millennia after they were all supposed to have died in each other's minds, all having independently become immortal/come back to life in their own independent adventures/stories.
It's another Dynamic I've never quite seen before, and the series is much better for it.

I am so glad I found out about you. I honestly don't know how I would've made it through this crappy year without your great stuff. (Aside from the fact I would feel invariably worse.).
